about: V11 PB-NFR-08: the fixed set of 20 sample dreams the plan builder is tried on before a prompt or model change ships. 10 English, 5 Khmer, 5 deliberately vague. Owned by the AI governance lead; change it only on purpose, and note the change in docs/CHANGELOG.md.

dreams.title: Own a two-bedroom home in Phnom Penh
dreams.whyImportant: My children need their own room and stable schooling
dreams.successDefinition: Keys in hand and a mortgage I can pay from one salary

dreams.title: Become a certified public health researcher
dreams.whyImportant: I want my work to shape health policy
dreams.successDefinition: A research certificate and one published paper

dreams.title: Run a half marathon
dreams.whyImportant: I want energy to keep up with my kids

dreams.title: Open a small coffee shop near the university
dreams.whyImportant: I want my own income and a place for students
dreams.successDefinition: Open six days a week and break even by month six

dreams.title: Save an emergency fund of six months of expenses
dreams.whyImportant: One illness should not put my family in debt
dreams.successDefinition: Six months of costs in a separate savings account

dreams.title: Reach IELTS band 7
dreams.whyImportant: I need it to apply for a master's abroad
dreams.successDefinition: An official IELTS result of 7.0 or more

dreams.title: Take my parents on a trip to Angkor Wat
dreams.whyImportant: They have never had a holiday
dreams.successDefinition: A three-day trip, fully paid, with everyone well

dreams.title: Lead a team of five at work
dreams.whyImportant: I want to grow and help others grow
dreams.successDefinition: Promoted to team lead with a team that stays

dreams.title: Start a weekend reading club for village children
dreams.whyImportant: Children near my home have no books
dreams.successDefinition: Twenty children reading every Saturday for a year

dreams.title: Publish one paper in a peer-reviewed journal
dreams.successDefinition: An accepted paper with me as first author

dreams.title: មានផ្ទះផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនមួយនៅខេត្តសៀមរាប
dreams.whyImportant: ខ្ញុំចង់ឱ្យគ្រួសារមានកន្លែងស្នាក់នៅស្ថិរភាព
dreams.successDefinition: ទទួលបានកូនសោផ្ទះ និងបង់ប្រាក់ប្រចាំខែបាន

dreams.title: បើកហាងលក់សម្លៀកបំពាក់តាមអនឡាញ
dreams.whyImportant: ខ្ញុំចង់មានប្រាក់ចំណូលបន្ថែម
dreams.successDefinition: លក់បាន ១០០ ដុំក្នុងមួយខែ

dreams.title: បញ្ចប់ថ្នាក់បរិញ្ញាបត្រផ្នែកគណនេយ្យ
dreams.whyImportant: ខ្ញុំចង់ទទួលបានការងារល្អជាងនេះ

dreams.title: ស្រកទម្ងន់ ១០ គីឡូក្រាម
dreams.whyImportant: ខ្ញុំចង់មានសុខភាពល្អសម្រាប់កូនៗ
dreams.successDefinition: ទម្ងន់ខ្លួនធ្លាក់ ១០ គីឡូ ហើយរក្សាបាន

dreams.area: ហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ
dreams.title: សងបំណុលទាំងអស់
dreams.whyImportant: ខ្ញុំចង់ធូរស្រាលពីការព្រួយបារម្ភ
dreams.successDefinition: គ្មានបំណុលនៅសល់ទាល់តែសោះ
